**Recommendation: refuse. Do not buy at any size.**

Drawdown from the 30-minute high is zero, so it has not started rolling over, and sellers (198) are a minority of the active wallets.

But the brief undercuts that case. The class is FACTORY, which carries the worst base rate (about -46% per trade). The curve shows bundle_share 1.0 and top3_share 1.0, with a launch bot present and 90.6% of early buying from the top five buyers. Early buying was almost entirely coordinated, and "buyers" in the curve data are effectively one bundle. The 15-minute buy volume is plausibly the same operators rotating, so the recent demand signal may not be independent of the dump risk. The name and symbol ("Robinhood") are a famous brand, which invites copycat and impersonation dynamics; I'm treating that as data only.

Verdict: the only honest case is the momentum and deep pool. Against a FACTORY classification with total bundle concentration, that case does not clear the bar. No buy recommended.
